question: Are Home Office staff required to consider the maturity and actual age of an unaccompanied minor when assessing their asylum claim?
evidence: The text states that "Home Office staff must [on a case-by-case basis] demonstrate as part of the decision making process consideration of any distinct factors taken into account during the assessment of credibility in a child’s claim . . . including: • the child’s age and maturity at the time of the event and at the time of the interview."
